Bacterial Spot.symptoms: Small dark water-soaked spots that may develop yellow margins.
Bacterial Spot.treatment: Remove badly affected leaves, improve airflow and avoid splashing foliage.

Early Blight.symptoms: Brown target-like spots, commonly on older leaves.
Early Blight.treatment: Remove affected leaves and keep foliage dry.

Late Blight.symptoms: Dark water-soaked lesions that may spread quickly.
Late Blight.treatment: Remove infected material promptly and avoid overhead watering.

Leaf Mold.symptoms: Yellow patches on upper leaf surfaces with mould-like growth below.
Leaf Mold.treatment: Improve ventilation and reduce prolonged leaf moisture.

Septoria Leaf Spot.symptoms: Numerous small circular spots with darker borders.
Septoria Leaf Spot.treatment: Remove infected lower leaves and reduce leaf wetness.

Spider Mites.symptoms: Fine stippling, bronzing and possible webbing on leaves.
Spider Mites.treatment: Isolate affected plants and wash leaf undersides.

Target Spot.symptoms: Circular brown lesions that may form concentric rings.
Target Spot.treatment: Remove affected tissue and improve airflow.

Yellow Leaf Curl Virus.symptoms: Upward leaf curling, yellowing and reduced growth.
Yellow Leaf Curl Virus.treatment: Remove severely affected plants and control whitefly vectors.

Mosaic Virus.symptoms: Mottled light and dark green leaf pattern with distortion.
Mosaic Virus.treatment: Remove infected plants and disinfect tools.

Apple Scab.symptoms: Olive-brown leaf lesions and possible fruit scabbing.
Apple Scab.treatment: Remove fallen infected leaves and improve airflow.

Black Rot.symptoms: Purple-edged leaf spots and possible fruit rot.
Black Rot.treatment: Remove infected tissue and prune dead wood.

Cedar Apple Rust.treatment: Remove nearby alternate host material where practical and improve airflow.

Alternaria Leaf Spot.symptoms: Brown circular leaf lesions that may enlarge.
Alternaria Leaf Spot.treatment: Remove infected leaves and reduce prolonged wetness.

Brown Spot.symptoms: Brown necrotic spots on leaf tissue.
Brown Spot.treatment: Prune affected material and keep foliage dry.

Frogeye Leaf Spot.symptoms: Circular spots with purple margins and lighter centres.
Frogeye Leaf Spot.treatment: Remove infected debris and prune dead wood.

Grey Spot.symptoms: Grey-brown leaf lesions with defined margins.
Grey Spot.treatment: Remove affected leaves and improve airflow.

Mosaic.symptoms: Patchy light/dark green mosaic-like leaf colouring.
Mosaic.treatment: Remove infected tissue and disinfect tools.

Powdery Mildew.symptoms: White powdery fungal growth on leaves and shoots.
Powdery Mildew.treatment: Prune affected growth and improve ventilation.

Black Rot.symptoms: Dark leaf lesions and possible fruit rot.
Black Rot.treatment: Remove infected material and improve airflow.

Esca (Black Measles).symptoms: Interveinal striping or scorch-like leaf symptoms.
Esca (Black Measles).treatment: Prune infected wood and maintain vine hygiene.

Leaf Blight.symptoms: Brown angular or irregular necrotic leaf areas.
Leaf Blight.treatment: Remove infected leaves and reduce moisture on foliage.

Downy Mildew.symptoms: Yellow oil-like patches with pale downy growth below.
Downy Mildew.treatment: Improve airflow and keep foliage dry.

Powdery Mildew.symptoms: White powdery coating on leaves or fruit surfaces.
Powdery Mildew.treatment: Improve airflow and remove affected tissue.

Bacterial Rot.symptoms: Water-soaked or dark necrotic lesions may develop on affected leaf tissue, with local browning and tissue breakdown.
Bacterial Rot.treatment: Remove badly affected material, avoid working with wet foliage, improve airflow and sanitation, and monitor nearby leaves for spread.

Black Spot.symptoms: Dark circular spots with fringed margins and yellowing leaves.
Black Spot.treatment: Remove infected leaves and avoid wetting foliage.

Downy Mildew.symptoms: Purple-red or brown leaf blotches with pale downy growth below.
Downy Mildew.treatment: Improve airflow and keep foliage dry.

Powdery Mildew.symptoms: White powdery growth on leaves, stems or buds.
Powdery Mildew.treatment: Improve airflow and remove badly affected tissue.

Rose Mosaic.symptoms: Yellow line, ring or mosaic patterns on foliage.
Rose Mosaic.treatment: Remove severely affected plants and disinfect tools.

Rose Rust.symptoms: Orange rust-coloured pustules, often beneath leaves.
Rose Rust.treatment: Remove infected leaves and improve airflow.

Insect Damage.symptoms: Holes, chewed margins or visible feeding damage.
Insect Damage.treatment: Inspect both leaf surfaces and remove visible pests.

Common Rust.symptoms: Small cinnamon-brown to reddish pustules scattered across the leaf surface.
Common Rust.treatment: Remove badly affected leaves where practical, improve airflow, avoid prolonged leaf wetness, and monitor new growth.

Gray Leaf Spot.symptoms: Rectangular grey to tan lesions that often run parallel to leaf veins and may merge when severe.
Gray Leaf Spot.treatment: Remove infected debris, improve airflow, avoid overhead watering, and keep foliage as dry as practical.

Northern Leaf Blight.symptoms: Long cigar-shaped grey-green or tan lesions that expand along the leaf and can reduce healthy leaf area.
Northern Leaf Blight.treatment: Remove heavily affected material, clear infected debris, avoid prolonged leaf wetness, and improve spacing and airflow.
